interpretations: Group tracks by media type name, including only tracks with a linked media type. For each group, calculate `SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds)` and count its tracks. Find the unweighted average of those group rates, then return one unrounded row containing the average rate, average track count, and average excess over that overall rate for groups whose rate is above it.
queries:
WITH media_type_groups AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY mt.Name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
    FROM media_type_groups
)
SELECT
    overall.average_rate,
    AVG(media_type_groups.track_count) AS average_track_count,
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN media_type_groups.rate > overall.average_rate
            THEN media_type_groups.rate - overall.average_rate
        END
    ) AS average_excess
FROM media_type_groups
CROSS JOIN overall;
